products.name: Rosenfeld Perception Engine
products.purpose: Industrial perception and sensor-fusion layer that converts camera, depth, LiDAR, force and other sensor streams into a structured, machine-usable representation of the operating environment.
products.buyers: Industrial manufacturers, process industries, logistics operators, machine builders, automated inspection teams.
products.included: Up to 12 production sensor streams, 2 edge compute nodes, 1 production line, 2 model families, standard API integration, quarterly model review.
products.direct_cost: €28,000 / site / year standard recurring delivery COGS
products.delivery_time: 6–10 weeks for first deployment; 2–4 weeks for additional standardized sites
products.key_kpis: precision/recall, defect escape rate, latency, calibration drift, false-alert rate, uptime
products.moat: Industrial deployment data, calibration know-how, failure replay, integration library and customer-specific models.

products.name: Rosenfeld Motion Stack
products.purpose: Planning, task execution and hybrid learned/model-based control for robot cells and mobile manipulation systems.
products.buyers: Manufacturers with existing robots, automation integrators, machinery companies, industrial engineering teams.
products.included: Up to 2 robots, 4 end-effectors, 2 production recipes, standard PLC / fieldbus interface and performance monitoring.
products.direct_cost: €36,000 / cell / year standard recurring delivery COGS
products.delivery_time: 8–14 weeks for initial cell; 4–8 weeks for cloned cells
products.key_kpis: cycle time, task success rate, recovery rate, collision / stop events, uptime, operator intervention minutes
products.moat: Cross-morphology task-policy transfer, failure recovery data and a growing library of industrial motions.

products.name: Rosenfeld Fleet Intelligence
products.purpose: Turns deployed machines into a connected learning fleet through telemetry, failure classification, fleet monitoring and policy-update workflows.
products.buyers: Industrial operators with multiple robot cells, AMR fleets, machine OEMs and multi-site manufacturers.
products.included: Up to 25 active robots in the base fee, standard telemetry, monitoring, user accounts and one fleet data connector.
products.direct_cost: €14,000 / site / year base + €300 / active robot / year
products.delivery_time: 4–8 weeks for first fleet; 2–4 weeks for additional sites
products.key_kpis: fleet uptime, mean time to recovery, failure recurrence, utilization, intervention rate, update adoption
products.moat: Closed-loop fleet data: deployment → failure → correction → validated update → redeployment.

products.name: Rosenfeld Simulation Core
products.purpose: Physics-aware simulation, synthetic data generation, digital-twin testing and failure-replay environment for industrial autonomy.
products.buyers: Industrial manufacturers, automation teams, robot OEMs, engineering groups and RAS customers preparing deployments.
products.included: One production cell or process model, scenario library, automated regression suite and standard CI/API integration.
products.delivery_time: 8–16 weeks for initial digital twin; 4–8 weeks for extensions
products.key_kpis: sim-to-real transfer rate, scenario coverage, regression detection rate, test throughput, escaped failure rate
products.moat: Failure-replay corpus and customer-specific operational models that become increasingly valuable with every deployment.

products.name: Rosenfeld Manipulation Lab Stack
products.purpose: Research and partner environment for contact-rich manipulation, force control, grasping, tool interaction and hard physical tasks.
products.buyers: Strategic industrial partners, research collaborators and selected lighthouse customers; not general availability.
products.included: 4 named research users, API access, two engineering sprints per quarter and shared evaluation framework.
products.delivery_time: 10–16 weeks to establish a partner environment
products.key_kpis: task success, recovery success, force overshoot, grasp stability, tool-use completion, intervention rate
products.moat: Proprietary contact-rich datasets and physical correction data; intended to seed later generations of Motion and Autonomy products.

services.name: Discovery & System Architecture
services.purpose: Process mapping, site audit, sensor/robot inventory, target KPI definition, deployment architecture and ROI baseline.

services.name: Deployment & Integration
services.cost: €72,000 direct delivery cost, excluding customer hardware purchased on behalf of client
services.purpose: Install software stack, connect PLC/robot/sensor interfaces, calibrate, validate production workflows and commission the system.

services.name: Robotics Engineering
services.purpose: Custom robot-cell engineering, mechanical/electrical interfaces, controls, fixtures, end-effector integration, test and recovery work.

services.name: Data & Fleet Operations
services.purpose: Telemetry governance, dataset curation, fleet analytics, failure triage, model evaluation and controlled update operations.

services.name: Support & Lifecycle
services.purpose: Remote support, incident handling, software updates, health checks, SLA management and periodic performance review.

services.name: OEM / IP Licensing
services.price: €250,000 upfront field-of-use license + 6.0% royalty on defined licensee net sales; minimum annual royalty €100,000
services.cost: €20,000 average legal / enablement cost for standard agreement
services.purpose: License selected RAS algorithms, schemas or software components to equipment manufacturers under defined field-of-use and territory restrictions.

rules.hardware: RAS integrates third-party/customer robots in 2026; no mass-market proprietary robot catalog item frozen
rules.price_book: List prices are canonical simulation assumptions; actual contract price can be an explicit deviation.
rules.revenue_reconciliation: Product/service sub-ledger must reconcile to corporate ledger before it can alter revenue.
